newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Oil to keep current wholesale price formula.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Oil to keep current wholesale price formula.

text.p: Refiner Nippon Oil Co Ltd said on Monday it will maintain its current wholesale pricing system for gasoline, kerosene and gas oil for the next fiscal year starting in April.
"We intend to roll over the current formula into the coming fiscal year," a Nippon Oil spokesman said.
Another major refiner Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd earlier this year said it was considering revising its pricing system.
The company said oil product prices on overseas markets are not properly reflected under the current pricing system.
It also said that distribution costs differ between various areas, and that this is not mirrored in the current formula.

Ahead of the deregulation of oil product imports in April, 1996, most oil firms in Japan, including Nippon Oil and Idemitsu Kosan introduced new wholesale pricing systems, in which pre-tax prices for gasoline are set nearly in line with those for kerosene and gas oil.
Prior to the current systems, prices for gasoline, deemed to be a luxury, were set higher than those for kerosene and gas oil, which were considered necessities.
In addition, price differentials between regions were abolished under the new system.
